message:
perf: build converted objects with interned keys (#54207)

Returning a structure was the most expensive thing the converters did:
each field went through Object::Set, a generic store that walks the
prototype chain, and each key was internalized from scratch, so V8
hashed it and probed the string table on every call.

InternedString caches the key handle per isolate. ObjectBuilder defines
the fields as own data properties on a fresh object, so the result has
the same shape and prototype an object literal would. The gfx converters
(Point, Size, Rect, Insets, Display) use it.

Testing build, ns per call:

| call                       | before | after |
|----------------------------|-------:|------:|
| win.getBounds()            |   4197 |  2304 |
| screen.getPrimaryDisplay() |  31014 | 12830 |
